title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Marowak Scarlet & Violet 105/165 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Marowak card is a must-have for any Pokémon collector! With its stunning holo finish and holo rare status, it's sure to be a standout addition to your collection. The card features Marowak, a Stage 2 Fighting-type Pokémon with 120 HP and a card number of 105/165. 

This Japanese card is from the Scarlet & Violet set and was manufactured by Nintendo in 2023. The card is made of high-quality card stock and features artwork by Shinya Komatsu. It's perfect for players of the Pokémon TCG and collectors alike. Add this card to your collection today!
